summary: A Yes vote sets the Street Paving and Storm Drain special parcel tax at $0.0638 per lot square foot and adds low-income exemptions and rebates, raising about $1.4 million per year until ended by voters.

tax.text: The League supports Measure P, which continues funding for Albany street paving and storm-drain work through a special tax.
tax.quote: Measure P — Street Paving & Storm Drain Tax : SUPPORT

tax.text: A No vote would reject Measure P’s authorization for the city to levy a potentially higher parcel tax for street paving and storm drains.
tax.quote: A yes vote would allow the city to levy a tax of up to $0.0638 per lot square foot on all parcels
